scope: Spline acceptance threshold Acc015, 3D Bayesian only, on a copy of fits/spline/acceptance_threshold/Acc015/fit_copy.root. Q2-y 1-17, 452 histograms. RC_Bayesian, BC_RC_Bayesian, Bin, and 5D are absent and were not created. No publication. The source ROOT file, budgets, sector exclusions, histogram weights, and the shared Phi_h guides were not edited. The destination did not already contain refinement_note.json and fit.json, so this is not a resume.
start_mode: manual. start=auto: the 3D spline B windows for these 452 histograms have median width 0.0153 and 428 are narrower than 0.05, and the C windows have median width 0.0070 with 445 of 452 narrower than 0.05, so those windows can pin a fit. The run-local guide started as Phi_h_Fit_Parameters_Initialize.py. --use_spline_init was not passed.

why_retained: Pass 2 is kept because 29 histograms are better than the stored fit by more than 0.5 in chi-squared and none is worse (largest increase 0.0014). The curves follow each Acc015 histogram, including (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_8), whose pinned B=-0.045 was the second-pass edge of a limit that excluded this histogram's cosine. The result was not moved onto nominal B=-0.125184 except where this histogram's cosine already lies there. Near-zero second-pass errors are a stability note, not a smaller systematic uncertainty. The trimmed-error list is histograms whose chi-squared already matched the cosine, so the limit was not opened. That trim is the fitter's second pass, not a smaller systematic uncertainty.
